collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: Two friends splash each other while washing in the stream.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: Two friends splash each other while washing in the stream. The splashing turns into a contest that nobody wins.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Two friends splash each other while washing in the stream. A passing elder gets splashed by accident and splashes back.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: Two friends splash each other while washing in the stream. A startled frog leaps between them, and both shriek.

e3__fx.name: Ending 3
e3__fx.text: Two friends splash each other while washing in the stream. They come out soaked and laughing, cleaner than they have been in days.
